title: Executive Order No. 49, s. 2018
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 49

EXEMPTING THE NATIONAL HOUSING AUTHORITY FROM THE
NATIONAL ECONOMIC AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY GUIDELINES
ON JOINT VENTURE AGREEMENTS TO- EXPEDITE THE
IMPLEMENTATION OF RECOVERY, RECONSTRUCTION AND
REHABILITATION PROJECTS IN THE MOST AFFECTED AREAS OF
MARAWI CITY

WHEREAS, Administrative Order (AO) No. 3 (s. 2017) created the Task Force
Bangon Marawi (TFBM) to ensure a unified and comprehensive effort on the part of the
National Government for the recovery, reconstruction and rehabilitation of Marawi City and
other affected localities;

WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 2(b) of AO No. 3, the TFBM shall develop and
implement the Bangon Marawi Comprehensive Rehabilitation and Recovery Plan (BM-
CRRP), which shall identify the most affected areas in Marawi City that have sustained the
most serious damage to public infrastructure and utilities, as well as private properties
located therein;

WHEREAS, AO No. 3 was amended by AO No. 9 (s. 2017) by reorganizing the
composition of the TFBM, designating the Housing and Urban Development Coordinating
Council (HUDCC) as head of the TFBM to reflect the government's current priority to
rebuild and develop the areas affected by the armed conflict in Marawi City;

WHEREAS, pursuant to AO No. 3, as amended, the HUDCC Chairman exercises
operational control and supervision of the TFBM and the overall responsibility to ensure that
the objectives of said the Order are accomplished;

WHEREAS, pursuant to EO No. 20 (s. 2001), the HUDCC exercises administrative
supervision over the National Housing Authority (NHA), which remains attached to it for
purposes of policy and program coordination;

WHEREAS, the NHA can provide the TFBM with the much-needed assistance and
technical know-how in the recovery and rehabilitation efforts for Marawi City;

WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 6(e) of Presidential Decree No. 757 (s. 1975), the
NHA is authorized to develop and undertake housing development and/or resettlement
projects through joint ventures or other arrangements with public and private entities;

WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 8 of EO No. 423 (s. 2005), the National Economic
and Development Authority (NEDA), in consultation with the Government Procurement

THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
 
Policy Board (GPPB), issued the “Revised Guidelines and Procedures for Entering into
Joint Venture Agreements between Government and Private Entities”;

WHEREAS, in order to simplify documentary requirements and procedures and
thereby expedite the commencement of rehabilitation projects, there is an urgent need to
exempt the NHA from the coverage of the NEDA Guidelines on JVAs;

NOW, THEREFORE, |, RODRIGO ROA DUTERTE, President of the Republic of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and existing laws, do
hereby order:

SECTION 1. Exempting the NHA from the NEDA Guidelines on Joint Venture
Agreements. To expedite the recovery, reconstruction and rehabilitation efforts in Marawi
City currently being undertaken by national government agencies led by the HUDCC, the
NHA, as an agency attached to the HUDCC, is hereby exempted from the NEDA Guidelines
on JVAs, subject to the parameters stated in Section 2 hereof.

SECTION 2. NHA Authority to Issue Guidelines. All JVAs to be entered into by the
NHA pursuant to this Order shall comply with Guidelines which the NHA shall formulate and
issue under the supervision of the HUDCC and in consultation with the NEDA, the Public-
Private Partnership Center, and the Department of Budget and Management.

Such guidelines shall (a) apply only to recovery, reconstruction and rehabilitation
projects for the most affected areas of Marawi City; (b) promote efficiency, transparency,
competitiveness and accountability in covered transactions; (c) require the participation of
agencies with mandates directly relevant to the project in the JVA selection and contracting
process; and (d) be consistent with all applicable laws, rules and regulations.

SECTION 3. Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon its
publication in a national newspaper of general circulation.

DONE, in the City of Manila thissth day of February-in the year of Our Lord, Two
Thousand and Eighteen.

 

By the President:
